figgy.title: Collections should be able to choose a representative image from its highlighted items, and crop it

comments.body: We're thinking we could do something similar to how it works in DPUL: search for a resource, select the image w/in that resource to use, then crop the image. We will probably have fewer options, e.g. no upload option and only resources in the collection would be available. screenshot:

Simplest approach that allows for MVW image inclusion is to allow the user to copy a IIIF image URL from the Figgy UV. That URL can be pasted into a field on a collection edit page and then present a crop UI. Steps: - [ ] Add the field to the collection model. `banner_image_url` - [ ] Modify the collection edit form. - a new edit field partial for banner_image_url - [ ] Preview / crop / zoom box - [ ] Add a method to get IIIF Image API link from Figgy UV for a single image. Format: `.../info.json`
